    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    a = int(input[1])
    b = int(input[2])
    s = input[3]

    k = a / b
    positions = defaultdict(list)
    for i, c in enumerate(s):
        positions[c].append(i)

    obtainable = set()
    for x, pos_list in positions.items():
        if len(pos_list) >= k * (pos_list[-1] - pos_list[0] + 1):
            obtainable.add(x)

    print(len(obtainable), ' '.join(sorted(obtainable)))

main()
